schema.text: On foot or in a wheelchair, how do roads with fast traffic affect you when you go along or cross them?

options.text: I feel a little uneasy but manage
I feel unsafe and stay near them as little as possible
I take much longer routes to avoid them
I avoid trips that make me use them
I don't use roads like these

en.#On foot or in a wheelchair, how do road: On foot or in a wheelchair, how do roads with fast traffic affect you when you go along or cross them?
en.#I feel a little uneasy but manage: I feel a little uneasy but manage
en.#I feel unsafe and stay near them as lit: I feel unsafe and stay near them as little as possible
en.#I take much longer routes to avoid them: I take much longer routes to avoid them
en.#I avoid trips that make me use them: I avoid trips that make me use them
en.#I don't use roads like these: I don't use roads like these

it.#On foot or in a wheelchair, how do road: A piedi o in sedia a rotelle, che effetto ti fanno le strade con traffico veloce quando le percorri o le attraversi?
it.#I feel a little uneasy but manage: Mi sento un po' a disagio, ma me la cavo
it.#I feel unsafe and stay near them as lit: Non mi sento al sicuro e ci passo il meno possibile
it.#I take much longer routes to avoid them: Faccio percorsi molto più lunghi per evitarle
it.#I avoid trips that make me use them: Evito gli spostamenti che mi obbligano a passarci
it.#I don't use roads like these: Non passo da strade di questo tipo

fr.#On foot or in a wheelchair, how do road: À pied ou en fauteuil roulant, quel effet ont sur vous les routes où la circulation est rapide quand vous les longez ou les traversez ?
fr.#I feel a little uneasy but manage: Je me sens un peu mal à l’aise, mais je peux continuer
fr.#I feel unsafe and stay near them as lit: Je ne me sens pas en sécurité et j’y reste le moins possible
fr.#I take much longer routes to avoid them: Je fais des détours bien plus longs pour les éviter
fr.#I avoid trips that make me use them: J’évite les trajets qui m’obligent à les emprunter
fr.#I don't use roads like these: Je n’emprunte pas de routes de ce genre

de.#On foot or in a wheelchair, how do road: Zu Fuß oder im Rollstuhl: Wie wirken Straßen mit schnellem Verkehr auf Sie, wenn Sie an ihnen entlanggehen oder sie überqueren?
de.#I feel a little uneasy but manage: Ich fühle mich etwas unwohl, komme aber zurecht
de.#I feel unsafe and stay near them as lit: Ich fühle mich unsicher und halte mich möglichst kurz dort auf
de.#I take much longer routes to avoid them: Ich nehme viel längere Wege, um sie zu vermeiden
de.#I avoid trips that make me use them: Ich vermeide Wege, auf denen ich sie benutzen muss

tr.#On foot or in a wheelchair, how do road: Yaya olarak veya tekerlekli sandalyedeyken, trafiğin hızlı aktığı yollar boyunca giderken ya da karşıdan karşıya geçerken kendinizi nasıl hissediyorsunuz?
tr.#I feel a little uneasy but manage: Biraz rahatsız hissederim ama idare ederim
tr.#I feel unsafe and stay near them as lit: Kendimi güvensiz hisseder ve orada olabildiğince az kalırım
tr.#I take much longer routes to avoid them: Onlardan kaçınmak için çok daha uzun güzergâhlar kullanırım

fa.#On foot or in a wheelchair, how do road: پیاده یا با ویلچر، وقتی در امتداد خیابان‌هایی با ترافیک پرسرعت راه می‌روید یا از آن‌ها عبور می‌کنید، چه احساسی دارید؟
fa.#I feel a little uneasy but manage: کمی ناراحت می‌شوم، اما می‌توانم ادامه دهم
fa.#I feel unsafe and stay near them as lit: احساس ناامنی می‌کنم و تا جای ممکن کمتر کنار آن‌ها می‌مانم
fa.#I take much longer routes to avoid them: برای دوری از آن‌ها مسیرهای بسیار طولانی‌تری انتخاب می‌کنم
fa.#I avoid trips that make me use them: از سفرهایی که مجبورم از آن‌ها استفاده کنم پرهیز می‌کنم
fa.#I don't use roads like these: از خیابان‌هایی از این نوع استفاده نمی‌کنم

hu.#On foot or in a wheelchair, how do road: Gyalog vagy kerekesszékkel hogyan hatnak Önre a gyors forgalmú utak, amikor mellettük halad vagy átkel rajtuk?
hu.#I feel a little uneasy but manage: Kicsit kényelmetlenül érzem magam, de megoldom
hu.#I feel unsafe and stay near them as lit: Nem érzem magam biztonságban, és a lehető legkevesebbet tartózkodom ott
hu.#I take much longer routes to avoid them: Sokkal hosszabb útvonalakat választok, hogy elkerüljem őket
hu.#I avoid trips that make me use them: Elkerülöm azokat az utakat, ahol használnom kell őket

ar.#On foot or in a wheelchair, how do road: سيرًا على الأقدام أو بكرسي متحرك، كيف تؤثر فيك الطرق ذات الحركة السريعة عند السير بمحاذاتها أو عبورها؟
ar.#I feel a little uneasy but manage: أشعر بعدم ارتياح بسيط لكنني أتدبر الأمر
ar.#I feel unsafe and stay near them as lit: أشعر بعدم الأمان وأقضي بقربها أقل وقت ممكن
ar.#I avoid trips that make me use them: أتجنب الرحلات التي تجبرني على استخدامها
ar.#I don't use roads like these: لا أستخدم طرقًا من هذا النوع
